output.headline: Strategic buyer whose only recorded deal, a 2022 platform investment, sits in the target's own sub-sector, but with no Midwest deal history.
output.differentiator: Its one deal, at $789M, is larger than any other buyer's median deal on the list and sits in the target's own sub-sector. Advocate and UPMC are the other strategics.
output.why_them: Sub-sector strategic with platform precedent; no Midwest presence yet

acquirer_overview.title: A Salt Lake City health system with one recorded deal, in this sub-sector
points: Headquartered in Salt Lake City, with 33 hospitals in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana; it left Kansas in 2024 [P:2].
Completed a merger with SCL Health in 2022, extending into Colorado, Kansas and Montana [P:1].
One deal on record, which closed (1 of 1), all in Healthcare Services. Buyer revenue is not researched [K:closed_share, K:by_sub_sector, V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Focus on the target's own sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor. Margin fit is a modest factor, and a deal no bigger than its largest is a slight one [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, S:not_bigger].
Its one deal carried Platform Build and Scale motives (1 of 1 each), tags found on only 23% of all deals in the file [M:platform_build, M:scale].
Against: deals in recent years is a slight negative signal, and it has no deal in the target's region [S:recency, K:by_region].

precedent_activity.title: One 2022 platform deal at 12.5x, far larger than the target
points: Paramount Care Partners: $789M Platform Investment in Healthcare Services, 2022, multi-regional, closed [D:MA-2022-0183].
None of its deals fall in the comparable $100M-$400M size band (0 of 1); the target's $200M is below its one deal [K:size_band, T:record].

valuation_context.title: Defend the 75th percentile; its own 12.5x is just under the median
points: 70 comparable deals show 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median and 15.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin is above the comps' 12.9% median and above 87% of comps, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Its own 12.5x rests on one deal. Cost-synergy headroom is $15M-$25M; buyer revenue is not researched, so capacity is unconfirmed [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: No Midwest foothold
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region and no Midwest hospitals in its footprint [K:by_region, P:2].
risk_flags.mitigant: The SCL Health merger shows it has entered new states by combination [P:1].
risk_flags.reality: It left Kansas in 2024, so Midwest commitment is unproven [P:2].

risk_flags.title: Thin acquisition record
risk_flags.concern: Only one deal, in 2022, with recent activity a slight negative signal [T:record, S:recency].
risk_flags.mitigant: That deal closed (1 of 1) and sits in the target's own sub-sector [K:closed_share, D:MA-2022-0183].
risk_flags.reality: One data point sets a Low conviction on its pricing and process behaviour [C:conviction].

risk_flags.title: Low place on the priority list
risk_flags.concern: It sits 10th of 10 on the priority list, with a likelihood of 3.6% [R:rank].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its sub-sector focus is the strongest factor and the target is no bigger than its largest deal [S:sector_share, S:not_bigger].
risk_flags.reality: Sponsors and strategics with more relevant records will set the competitive tension [R:rank].
